title: Fundamentals
description: Price, valuation and fundamentals for a single ticker, from the equity_metric_series view. The snapshot reads the latest values: price against a year earlier, and P/E, P/FCF and EV/EBITDA against their median over the time range. Valuation charts shade the middle half of each ratio's range around its median; growth, margins and the balance sheet have one point per report. Money values are converted into the selected currency at each day's (or report date's) FX rate; ratios and share counts are never converted.

links.title: Financial Statements
links.tooltip: This ticker's annual income statement, balance sheet and cash flow

target.rawSql: SELECT f.filed_at::timestamptz AS "time", f.form || ' filed' AS text, f.form AS tags FROM filings f WHERE f.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND f.form IN ('10-K', '10-Q', '20-F', '40-F') AND $__timeFilter(f.filed_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Price · 1y
panels.description: Latest close in the display currency. The arrow is the change over the last 12 months, whatever the time picker says.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.date::timestamptz AS "time", p.close::float8 * (CASE WHEN i.currency IS NULL OR i.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(i.currency, p.date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', p.date), 0), 1) END) AS "Price" FROM prices p JOIN instruments i ON i.id = p.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol = '$ticker' AND $__timeFilter(p.date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: P/E (TTM) · vs median
panels.description: P/E (TTM) on the last day of the time range. The arrow is how far it sits from its median over the same range: red above (pricier than usual), green below. Blank while TTM EPS is negative, or when the last report is older than ~15 months.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT s."time", s.value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'pe' AND $__timeFilter(s."time")), latest AS (SELECT s."time", s.value FROM s ORDER BY s."time" DESC LIMIT 1), last_day AS (SELECT l."time", l.value FROM latest l WHERE l.value IS NOT NULL AND l."time" > $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '31 days') SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.value) FROM s) AS "P/E (TTM)" FROM last_day UNION ALL SELECT c."time", c.value FROM last_day c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: P/FCF (TTM) · vs median

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT s."time", s.value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'ev_ebitda' AND $__timeFilter(s."time")), latest AS (SELECT s."time", s.value FROM s ORDER BY s."time" DESC LIMIT 1), last_day AS (SELECT l."time", l.value FROM latest l WHERE l.value IS NOT NULL AND l."time" > $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '31 days') SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS "time", (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.value) FROM s) AS "EV/EBITDA (TTM)" FROM last_day UNION ALL SELECT c."time", c.value FROM last_day c ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ${candle_interval:text} candles with 50- and 200-period averages — $display_currency
panels.description: Daily prices as OHLC candles, converted to the display currency and aggregated into the candle size chosen with the 'Candles' selector (daily / weekly / monthly), with traded volume along the bottom and 50- and 200-period simple moving averages of the close. The averages share the candles' price axis and their latest and mean values show in the legend. Turn on 'Earnings reports' at the top to mark the dates 10-K / 10-Q / 20-F / 40-F reports were filed.

targets.rawSql: WITH px AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT p.date, p.open, p.high, p.low, p.close, p.volume, CASE WHEN i.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(i.currency, p.date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', p.date), 0), 1) END AS fx FROM prices p JOIN instruments i ON i.id = p.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol = '$ticker'), daily AS (SELECT date_trunc('$candle_interval', date)::timestamptz AS bucket, date, COALESCE(open, close)::float8 * fx AS o, COALESCE(high, close)::float8 * fx AS h, COALESCE(low, close)::float8 * fx AS l, close::float8 * fx AS c, volume::float8 AS v FROM px), candles AS (SELECT bucket AS t, (array_agg(o ORDER BY date ASC))[1] AS o, max(h) AS h, min(l) AS l, (array_agg(c ORDER BY date DESC))[1] AS c, sum(v) AS v FROM daily GROUP BY bucket), sma AS (SELECT t, o, h, l, c, v, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER w50 = 50 THEN avg(c) OVER w50 END AS sma50, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER w200 = 200 THEN avg(c) OVER w200 END AS sma200 FROM candles WINDOW w50 AS (ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w200 AS (ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 199 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT t AS "time", o AS "open", h AS "high", l AS "low", c AS "close", v AS "volume", sma50 AS "SMA50", sma200 AS "SMA200" FROM sma WHERE $__timeFilter(t) ORDER BY t

panels.title: P/E (TTM)
panels.description: Daily close (in the reporting currency) over trailing-twelve-month diluted EPS. No point is drawn while TTM EPS is negative or the last report is older than ~15 months. The dashed line is its median over the time range and the shaded band the middle half of its values (25th to 75th percentile): above the band it trades richer than usual, below it cheaper.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT s."time", s.value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'pe' AND $__timeFilter(s."time")), q AS (SELECT percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.25, 0.5, 0.75]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.value) AS p FROM s WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL) SELECT s."time", s.value AS "P/E (TTM)", q.p[2] AS "Median", q.p[1] AS "25th percentile", q.p[3] AS "75th percentile" FROM s CROSS JOIN q ORDER BY 1

panels.title: P/FCF (TTM)
panels.description: Market cap (daily close × latest weighted diluted shares) over TTM free cash flow (operating cash flow minus capex). No point is drawn while TTM FCF is negative; missing if the filer doesn't tag capex. The dashed line is its median over the time range and the shaded band the middle half of its values (25th to 75th percentile): above the band it trades richer than usual, below it cheaper.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT s."time", s.value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'pfcf' AND $__timeFilter(s."time")), q AS (SELECT percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.25, 0.5, 0.75]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.value) AS p FROM s WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL) SELECT s."time", s.value AS "P/FCF (TTM)", q.p[2] AS "Median", q.p[1] AS "25th percentile", q.p[3] AS "75th percentile" FROM s CROSS JOIN q ORDER BY 1

panels.title: P/B
panels.description: Market cap over the latest reported stockholders' equity. No point is drawn while equity is zero or negative, or the last report is older than ~15 months. The dashed line is its median over the time range and the shaded band the middle half of its values (25th to 75th percentile): above the band it trades richer than usual, below it cheaper.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT s."time", s.value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'pb' AND $__timeFilter(s."time")), q AS (SELECT percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.25, 0.5, 0.75]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.value) AS p FROM s WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL) SELECT s."time", s.value AS "P/B", q.p[2] AS "Median", q.p[1] AS "25th percentile", q.p[3] AS "75th percentile" FROM s CROSS JOIN q ORDER BY 1

panels.title: EV/EBITDA (TTM)
panels.description: Enterprise value (market cap + total debt − cash) over TTM EBITDA (operating income + depreciation & amortization). No point is drawn while TTM EBITDA is zero or negative, or the last report is older than ~15 months. The dashed line is its median over the time range and the shaded band the middle half of its values (25th to 75th percentile): above the band it trades richer than usual, below it cheaper.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT s."time", s.value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'ev_ebitda' AND $__timeFilter(s."time")), q AS (SELECT percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.25, 0.5, 0.75]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.value) AS p FROM s WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL) SELECT s."time", s.value AS "EV/EBITDA (TTM)", q.p[2] AS "Median", q.p[1] AS "25th percentile", q.p[3] AS "75th percentile" FROM s CROSS JOIN q ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Revenue (TTM) — $display_currency
panels.description: Trailing-twelve-month revenue: one point per reported quarter end (annual filers get one point per fiscal year).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s."time", s.label AS metric, s.value * (CASE WHEN s.currency IS NULL OR s.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(s.currency, s."time"::date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', s."time"::date), 0), 1) END) AS value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'revenue' AND $__timeFilter(s."time") ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Earnings (TTM) — $display_currency
panels.description: Trailing-twelve-month net income: one point per reported quarter end (annual filers get one point per fiscal year).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s."time", s.label AS metric, s.value * (CASE WHEN s.currency IS NULL OR s.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(s.currency, s."time"::date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', s."time"::date), 0), 1) END) AS value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'earnings' AND $__timeFilter(s."time") ORDER BY 1

panels.title: EPS (TTM, diluted) — $display_currency
panels.description: Trailing-twelve-month diluted earnings per share (quarterly EPS summed, Q4 derived from the 10-K), the figure P/E divides by: one point per reported quarter end (annual filers get one point per fiscal year).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s."time", s.label AS metric, s.value * (CASE WHEN s.currency IS NULL OR s.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(s.currency, s."time"::date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', s."time"::date), 0), 1) END) AS value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'eps' AND $__timeFilter(s."time") ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Growth (TTM, year on year) — $display_currency
panels.description: Each report's trailing-twelve-month revenue and diluted EPS against the report a year earlier, in the display currency. EPS growth is left out while the year-earlier EPS isn't positive. The grey line marks 0%.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT s.metric, s."time", s.value * (CASE WHEN s.currency IS NULL OR s.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(s.currency, s."time"::date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', s."time"::date), 0), 1) END) AS v FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric IN ('revenue', 'eps') AND s.value IS NOT NULL AND s."time" <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz), g AS (SELECT c.metric, c."time", CASE WHEN p.v > 0 THEN 100.0 * (c.v - p.v) / p.v END AS growth FROM s c JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.v FROM s p WHERE p.metric = c.metric AND p."time" BETWEEN c."time" - interval '395 days' AND c."time" - interval '335 days' ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM p."time" - (c."time" - interval '365 days'))) LIMIT 1) p ON true) SELECT g."time", max(g.growth) FILTER (WHERE g.metric = 'revenue') AS "Revenue", max(g.growth) FILTER (WHERE g.metric = 'eps') AS "EPS (diluted)" FROM g WHERE $__timeFilter(g."time") GROUP BY g."time" ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Margins (TTM)
panels.description: Trailing-twelve-month gross profit (revenue minus cost of goods sold), operating income and net income, each as a percentage of TTM revenue: one point per reported quarter end (annual filers get one point per fiscal year).

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT s.metric, s."time", s.value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric IN ('gross_margin', 'op_margin', 'revenue', 'earnings') AND $__timeFilter(s."time")) SELECT s."time", max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'gross_margin') AS "Gross margin", max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'op_margin') AS "Operating margin", 100.0 * max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'earnings') / NULLIF(max(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'revenue'), 0) AS "Net margin" FROM s GROUP BY s."time" ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total debt — $display_currency
panels.description: Balance-sheet debt at each report date, composed from the components the filer tags (long-term debt incl. current portion, plus short-term borrowings) without double counting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s."time", s.label AS metric, s.value * (CASE WHEN s.currency IS NULL OR s.currency = '$display_currency' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(fx_usd_rate(s.currency, s."time"::date) / NULLIF(fx_usd_rate('$display_currency', s."time"::date), 0), 1) END) AS value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'debt' AND $__timeFilter(s."time") ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Shares outstanding
panels.description: Weighted diluted share count from each report (the same series market cap and P/FCF use); a falling line means buybacks, a rising one dilution.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s."time", s.label AS metric, s.value AS value FROM equity_metric_series s WHERE s.instrument_id = (SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE symbol = '$ticker') AND s.metric = 'shares' AND $__timeFilter(s."time") ORDER BY 1
